title: Height bound from a net and a plane close to the net points (book (5)-(6))
statement: Let n, l be natural numbers, T a linear subspace of R^(n+l) with orthogonal projection p_T (T.starProjection), xi, x_0 in R^(n+l), S a subset of R^(n+l), F a finite subset of R^(n+l), and a, b real numbers. Assume |x_0 - xi| <= a, assume |(x_0 - y) - p_T(x_0 - y)| <= b for every y in F, and assume every x in S has some y in F with dist(x, y) <= a. Then dist(x - xi, T) = inf{|x - xi - t| : t in T} <= b + 2a for every x in S.
lean_statement: ∀ (n ℓ : ℕ) (T : Submodule ℝ (Amb n ℓ)) (ξ x₀ : Amb n ℓ) (S : Set (Amb n ℓ)) (F : Finset (Amb n ℓ)) (a b : ℝ), ‖x₀ - ξ‖ ≤ a → (∀ y ∈ F, ‖(x₀ - y) - T.starProjection (x₀ - y)‖ ≤ b) → (∀ x ∈ S, ∃ y ∈ F, dist x y ≤ a) → ∀ x ∈ S, infDist (x - ξ) (T : Set (Amb n ℓ)) ≤ b + 2 * a
